title: First deploy tags on production: backfill the 1eed288 deploy and prove the next scripts/deploy.sh run pushes its tag and runs the deploy-alone guard
acceptance: The conductor backfills deploy/2026-11-24T0237Z-1eed288 on 1eed288 (the 2026-11-23 deploy: Worker 515bc8fb-24fd-4ff7-b8be-6f7c28aa1e85, rollback fedc7fbf-1bc2-46cd-a90a-3059505e0a7b, SPA assets/index-CFKeSijz.js) right after #796 merges and before any deploy, and pushes only that ref; git ls-remote --tags origin shows it and pnpm release:status reads it.
